# End-to-End Machine Learning

**Estimated time: 7 hours**

Read **Chapter 2: End-to-End Machine Learning Project** from *Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras & TensorFlow*.

This is a long, dense chapter containing many concepts that may be new to you. You are **not expected to understand everything on the first reading**.

The purpose of this chapter is to give you a big-picture view of what a complete machine learning project looks like, from framing the problem and exploring the data to preparing the data, training models, evaluating them, and preparing a system for use.

For example, you will encounter techniques such as feature scaling and methods such as `fit_transform`. At this stage, it is more important to understand **where and why** these techniques appear in the workflow than to master every technical detail.

After completing the reading, you should be able to:

- list the main stages of a typical machine learning project;
- explain the purpose of the major stages;
- recognize the iterative nature of machine learning projects.

Use the three-pass method below.

## First Pass: Get the Big Picture — 90 minutes

Focus on building a map of the complete project.

- Read the *Working with Real Data* section.
- Carefully read *Look at the Big Picture* and *Frame the Problem*.
- Read all other section titles and subheadings to understand the flow of the project.
- Look at the figures, code blocks, and output plots.
- Read their captions.
- Read the exercise questions at the end of the chapter.

**Goal:** Build a mental map of the full machine learning project lifecycle and understand the sequence of steps involved.

## Second Pass: Read for Understanding — 4 hours

Read the chapter more carefully from start to finish.

Do not get stuck on individual equations, lines of code, or unfamiliar methods. Make a note of concepts that are unclear and keep moving.

Focus primarily on **what is being done and why**.

For example:

- data is being explored to understand its characteristics;
- missing values are being handled;
- features are being transformed;
- models are being trained;
- models are being compared and improved.

At this stage, understanding the purpose of each step is more important than mastering every implementation detail.

**Goal:** Follow the narrative of the project and understand the purpose of each major step.

## Third Pass: Connect Text to Code — 60 minutes

Open the official Chapter 2 notebook from the book's GitHub repository:

https://github.com/ageron/handson-ml3/blob/main/02_end_to_end_machine_learning_project.ipynb

Open it in Colab or your preferred notebook environment.

- Skim through the notebook.
- Run a few cells that interest you.
- Find examples of concepts you encountered in the chapter.
- Connect the conceptual steps in the text to their implementation in Python.

**Goal:** See how the stages of an end-to-end machine learning project translate into working code.

## Optional

If you want to explore the chapter further, try some of the exercises at the end.
